schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Security updates never wait for the weekly window, and never batch with anything else.

CI actions are pinned to commit SHAs on purpose (advisory SEC-P2-01). Renovate keeps the SHA current and rewrites the `# vN` comment beside it; without this the pins would rot into a security theatre of very old, very pinned actions.

Base images are pinned by digest (SEC-P2-02) for the reason the Containerfile states: a release image must not change because a base tag moved between two runs. Renovate moves the digest deliberately, as a reviewable diff.
The desktop shell is a separate, unbuilt workspace (D13). Group its updates so they never arrive mixed with server changes that a gate can actually verify.
Rust patch releases across the workspace, batched. The floor is `rust-version` in Cargo.toml, which Renovate must not raise on its own.
Typescript majors touch the whole web build; keep them separate and unbatched.

customManagers.description: Keep the mise installer's pinned checksum honest (SEC-P2-03). The workflows fetch a fixed version of install.sh rather than the floating one, so its version has to be maintained like any other dependency.
